cli.install_help.install: Manage the local install generations (layout for the stable `lop` runtime)
cli.install_help.prune: Delete install generations nothing is running from
cli.install_help.keep: How many unreferenced generations to keep (default: %(default)s; 0 or more). A generation named by a live or saved session, and the one `current` points at, are never removed
cli.install_help.migrate: Copy this install into the generation layout and point `current` at it
cli.install_help.status: Show the install layout: pointer, generations and what a new `lop` would load
